item.description:
Score: 5.45
A VPN provider named Windscribe has released an open-source script called "deGDID" designed to block Microsoft's Global Device Identifier (GDID) tracking on Windows PCs. The script operates by purging cached GDID keys from the registry and modifying Access Control Lists to prevent the operating system from re-minting new identifiers. While effective at blocking new tracking, the process can cause core Microsoft cloud services to malfunction, and the script is only functional on unmanaged systems with administrative access.
